definition: Centralization means the gathering of power or control into a single central authority.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word centralization. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know centralization should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: After centralization, the six regional academies answered to one national director, down to the color of the training bibs.
Coordination is far lighter than centralization — the branches agree on a common calendar and keep every decision their own; nothing about who decides ever moves to the center.
Absolutism goes further than centralization — a centralized service still runs on rules that bind the center itself; under absolutism the center answers to nothing.

Concentration is the piling up of power in fewer hands, wherever it happens to land — a committee, a rich family, a single office. Centralization is more specific: the power flows to the recognized center of the system, the top of the org chart, and rules from there.

Unification joins separate things into one whole — two countries, two leagues, two firms become a single body with a single name. Centralization can leave every part standing exactly where it was and take only the deciding: the branches survive, but their say moves to the center.

The new director changed that in eighteen months, in a process the board minutes called centralization.
